result.title: Gradient TD($λ$) for Non-Linear Function Approximation
result.summary: Temporal difference (TD) learning is central to reinforcement learning. Many methods use semi-gradient TD, which may diverge, or develop algorithms with mean-squared Bellman or TD-error objectives that are difficult to analyze. Gradient TD algorithms overcome these challenges by using projection of the value function and present convergent off-policy algorithms. However, the algorithm for $λ$-return was limited to linear function approximation. Here, we extend the same to non-linear function approximation, which is desirable since many strong modern function approximators are complex and non-linear. Recent works have derived similar algorithms with a generalized projected Bellman error objective. Alternatively, we continue working with the projected Bellman error.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 gradient TD(λ) 从线性函数逼近推广到非线性函数逼近，继续沿用投影 Bellman 误差目标来推导可收敛的 off-policy λ-return 算法，目前为初步工作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用投影 Bellman 误差约束非线性逼近器上的自举式状态更新并给出收敛视角，可能为循环/迭代式 latent 推理状态的稳定训练与发散诊断提供概念参照，迁移性需核查。
